static_findings.snippet: Guide creation of distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces that avoid generic "AI slop" aes
- **Organic/Natural**: Earthy tones, fluid shapes, soft shadows
- **Editorial/Magazine**: Bold typography, grid layouts, dynamic composition
- Consider variable fonts for fluid scaling
- Create atmospheric backgrounds instead of solid colors
**Goal**: Create atmosphere and depth, not just solid colors

content.value_statement: Generic frontend prompts often produce predictable layouts and weak visual direction. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code toward polished, distinctive interface work.
actual_capabilities: Guides selection of bold aesthetic directions for web pages, components, and applications.
Provides typography, color, motion, layout, and background design guidance.
Includes CSS and React examples for atmospheric backgrounds and staggered motion.
Defines production requirements for accessibility, performance, responsiveness, and polish.
Supplies a quality checklist for reviewing frontend design before delivery.
limitations: It is a guidance skill, not a runnable design system or component library.
It does not include automated accessibility, performance, or visual regression tests.
It provides examples but does not guarantee brand compliance without project context.
It may encourage high visual complexity that needs careful performance review.

use_cases.title: Design A New Product Page
use_cases.description: Use the skill to define typography, colors, layout, and motion before implementing a production page.

use_cases.title: Raise Prototype Quality
use_cases.description: Use the skill to turn a rough product idea into a more memorable visual direction.

use_cases.title: Create A Distinctive Component
use_cases.description: Use the skill to make a component feel specific, polished, responsive, and accessible.

prompt_templates.title: Choose A Direction
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the frontend-design skill to propose three visual directions for a dashboard. Include typography, color, layout, and motion choices.

prompt_templates.title: Design A Landing Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the frontend-design skill to create a polished landing page concept for [product]. Focus on a memorable first viewport and responsive structure.

prompt_templates.title: Refine An Existing Interface
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the frontend-design skill to review this interface description: [details]. Identify generic choices and propose specific improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Build A Production UI System
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the frontend-design skill to plan and implement a frontend experience for [application]. Include accessibility, performance, responsive behavior, and visual QA checks.

output_examples.input: Design a landing page for a climate analytics product.
output_examples.output: A visual direction with editorial typography, atmospheric color choices, responsive layout priorities, and motion notes.

output_examples.input: Improve a generic React hero section.
output: Clearer aesthetic direction and stronger typographic hierarchy.
More specific color, spacing, and interaction guidance.
Accessibility and mobile layout checks before delivery.

output_examples.input: Prepare a review checklist for a new portfolio page.
output_examples.output: A focused checklist covering visual direction, typography, motion, responsiveness, accessibility, performance, and production polish.

best_practices: Start with audience, purpose, and constraints before choosing visual style.
Use distinctive typography and color choices that support the product context.
Review accessibility, responsiveness, and performance before delivery.
anti_patterns: Using the same generic font, gradient, and card layout for every project.
Adding decorative motion that distracts from the user workflow.
Choosing complex visuals without testing mobile layout and performance.

faq.question: Does this skill write code?
faq.answer: It guides implementation and includes examples. The assistant still needs project files and framework details to produce final code.

faq.question: Can it work with React or Next.js?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes React examples and general CSS guidance for React, Next.js, or static HTML.

faq.question: Does it replace a design system?
faq.answer: No. It helps form a visual direction and implementation approach, but it does not provide a complete design system.

faq.question: Is it accessibility focused?
faq.answer: It requires WCAG AA as a baseline, but it does not run automated accessibility tests.

faq.question: Who should use it?
faq.answer: Frontend developers, design engineers, and product teams can use it to improve visual quality and reduce generic output.

faq.question: Can it create brand-specific designs?
faq.answer: Yes, when the prompt provides brand values, audience, content, and constraints. Without that context, it can only propose directions.
